1.web: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
1.asv: I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

2.web: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
2.asv: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

3.web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
3.asv: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.

4.web: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
4.asv: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.

5.web: Of the glorious majesty of your honor, of your wondrous works, I will meditate.
5.asv: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.

6.web: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
6.asv: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.

7.web: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
7.asv: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.

8.web: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
8.asv: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.

9.web: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
9.asv: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.

10.web: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
10.asv: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.

11.web: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power;
11.asv: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;

12.web: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
12.asv: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

13.web: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
13.asv: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

14.web: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
14.asv: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

15.web: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
15.asv: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.

16.web: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
16.asv: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

17.web: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
17.asv: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.

18.web: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
18.asv: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.

19.web: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
19.asv: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.

20.web: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
20.asv: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.

21.web: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
21.asv: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
